from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, json, hashlib
root=Path('.')
print('MANIFEST')
mp=root/'kopf_rgba_tiefe/parallax/manifest.json'
print(mp.read_text()[:12000] if mp.exists() else 'MISSING')
print('ANCHORS')
for ap in [root/'rig2/augen_anker_exakt.json', root/'augen_anker_gemessen.json']:
 print('FILE',ap)
 print(ap.read_text()[:12000] if ap.exists() else 'MISSING')
print('SOURCE_BIND')
rolls=['-25','-20','-15','-10','-05','+00','+05','+10','+15','+20','+25']
for r in rolls:
 d=root/f'kopf_rgba_parallax/gier_+00_nick_+00_roll_{r}'
 slices=[]
 for i in range(4):
  p=sorted(d.glob(f'slice_{i}_*.png'))[0]
  slices.append(np.array(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.uint16))
 asum=np.sum([x[:,:,3] for x in slices],axis=0).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8)
 # RGB should be same across overlaps; reconstruct RGB using highest-alpha slice per pixel
 stack=np.stack([x[:,:,3] for x in slices],axis=0)
 idx=np.argmax(stack,axis=0)
 rgb=np.zeros((1024,1536,3),dtype=np.uint8)
 for i,x in enumerate(slices):
  m=(idx==i)&(asum>0)
  rgb[m]=x[:,:,:3].astype(np.uint8)[m]
 for base_name in ['kopf_rgba/roll','kopf_rgba_tiefe/roll','kopf_rgba_tiefe_detail/roll']:
  p=root/base_name/f'gier_+00_nick_+00_roll_{r}.png'
  if not p.exists(): continue
  b=np.array(Image.open(p).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.uint8)
  alpha_eq=bool(np.array_equal(asum,b[:,:,3]))
  vis=b[:,:,3]>0
  rgb_mae=float(np.abs(rgb.astype(np.int16)-b[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16))[vis].mean()) if vis.any() else 0.0
  rgb_max=int(np.abs(rgb.astype(np.int16)-b[:,:,:3].astype(np.int16))[vis].max()) if vis.any() else 0
  print(r,base_name,'alpha_eq',alpha_eq,'rgb_mae',round(rgb_mae,6),'rgb_max',rgb_max,'sha',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
